images.screen: A · 봉랍 — 첫 날, 리나의 편지에 허가를 찍기 직전
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A top-down, perfectly flat 16:9 view of a celestial clerk's desk carved from pale white marble with soft grey veins, washed by cool morning light falling in two diagonal shafts from a high unseen window, fine dust motes in the light. Center: a handwritten letter on cream lined paper, slightly rotated, blue-black ink handwriting, a faint round receipt stamp '第一日' in blue ink. Left column: a stack of small cream envelopes forming an inbox, one pulled forward and highlighted. Below the letter: a row of source names with small round ink-blue tokens being allocated, the last token of each row outlined in dark red to mark a tolerance cliff. Right: an engraved double-entry ledger panel, 'received' column on the left, 'taken from' column on the right, with named debits in deep red and a thin before/after hardship bar. Bottom right: three textured sealing-wax stamps, jade green 許, oxblood 却, slate grey 留, with raised lumpy edges and soft drop shadows. Letters engraved into the stone with subtle top highlight. Minimal, cold, vast negative space, austere bureaucratic elegance. Korean UI text: '신의 비서', '장부의 좌우', '허가'. Content constraints: the letter is from "그의 딸 리나" (written down by her father) asking for 숨 during a three-day fever, signed "— 리나 (아버지가 대신 적음)"; the allocation rows are exactly "소금 굽는 카이드", "등짐꾼 타비", "약초 캐는 누르"; the ledger shows received "리나 · 숨 +5" on the left and taken "카이드 −2 · 타비 −2 · 누르 −1" on the right, both sides totaling 5; every debit has a name, never an anonymous or abstract source (no "누군가", "아직 태어나지 않은 생명").

images.screen: B · 장부를 덮는다 — 엿새째 밤, 결과 장부
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Night version of the same marble office: the stone is now dark blue-grey, lit only by pale moonlight through a tall mullioned window whose cross-shaped shadow falls over the desk, heavy vignette, fine film grain. Filling most of the frame, a large open ledger book with two slightly shadowed pages and a dark gutter. Left page: six dated rows (一 to 六), each with a small pressed wax seal, green 許 or oxblood 却, a name and a one-line handwritten quote in blue ink. Right page: eight named people, each with thin horizontal meters showing what they have versus what they need, green segments where they received, red hatched segments where something was taken, a thin red tick marking their tolerance limit, and a couple of rows labeled over the cliff in red. A thin red thread curves across the gutter from the sixth day to the fisherman's row. Along the bottom, engraved result figures in pale grey, and two unopened envelopes with grey 留 seals lying in the corner. Somber, quiet, no god figure anywhere. Korean UI text: '장부를 덮는다', '이름들', '벼랑 밖'. Text constraints: the right page lists exactly these eight names: "어부 마르코", "그의 딸 리나", "우물지기 오렌", "밀 기르는 헤사", "등짐꾼 타비", "약초 캐는 누르", "국수 마는 벨", "소금 굽는 카이드"; the left-page day rows use only these same names; the red thread ends at "어부 마르코"; no modern Korean personal names.
